newsitem.title: INDIA: India IPCL raises $175 mln in bond issue.
newsitem.headline: India IPCL raises $175 mln in bond issue.

text.p: Indian Petrochemicals Corporation Ltd (IPCL) raised $175 million through a convertible bond offering, lead manager Goldman Sachs said on Thursday.
"The size of the offering was $175 million including the $25 million over-allotment option," Goldman Sachs said in a statement.
The investment bank said the issue's maturity date is March 11, 2002. It said the yield to redemption is 4.61 percent or 155 basis points below 5-year U.S. treasuries.
"The cash coupon is 2.5 percent per annum payable semi-annually on March 11 and September 11, commencing September 11, 1997," the statement said.
The lead manager said the issue is convertible into global depositary shares (GDSs) or common shares underlying the GDSs, at the investors option.
The conversion price is $13.00, a 16.6 percent premium on the three-day average bid price of $11.15 of the firm's global depositary receipt listed in London.
State-run IPCL is a leading integrated petrochemicals maker.
